What Viant Technology says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue, expenses and adjusted EBITDAAt the midpoint of Q4 guidance, the Company expects full-year 2026 revenue of approximately $435 million, up 26% year-over-year, contribution ex-TAC of approximately $259 million, up 24% year-over-year, non-GAAP operating expenses of approximately $184 million, up 22% year-over-year, and adjusted EBITDA of approximately $75 million, up 31% year-over-year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 9, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
